# Draft:Abdulrahman Mohammed (software developer)

----
Abdulrahman Mohammed is a software developer working in the financial technology (FinTech) sector. He is associated with Hyperwallet Systems Inc., a PayPal service, where he contributes to developer-facing platforms, including REST API documentation, deployment automation, and command-line interface (CLI) tooling used in global payout systems.
Career
Mohammed works as a developer at Hyperwallet Systems Inc., a PayPal service that provides global payout and payment solutions for businesses. His work focuses on developer experience and platform engineering, particularly in the development and maintenance of RESTful API documentation, as well as supporting CI/CD deployment pipelines.
As part of his role, he has contributed to developer tooling and documentation that support integrations with Hyperwallet’s payout APIs, which are used by organizations to manage international payments and financial workflows.
